name: search_knowledge_base
description: Search the local knowledge base. by=content (default) searches contents and returns paths plus snippets; by=name finds files by name, directory, extension or path fragment. When a snippet is not enough, read the file with read using its kb: path. Mention paths only when useful or asked.

query.description: Search terms or the user's question; with by=name, a name, directory, extension or path fragment.
